channel.title: Violations Watch: Colombia
channel.description: New incidents reported in Colombia. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Car bomb outside the Meta Governor's Office in Villavicencio, Colombia, on the night of 23 Nov injures 22–23 people and damages more than 80 buildings; President blames FARC dissident (EMC) commander Antonio Medina
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Villavicencio, Colombia. Types: Destruction of property. Alleged perpetrator: FARC dissidents (EMC), according to the President and Meta's security secretary. Reported casualties: 22-23 injured. Disputed or caveats: No claim of responsibility reported; President blames EMC commander Antonio Medina, Meta's security secretary blames the EMC's 39th Front; under investigation. 7 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2033

item.title: Drone attack on a police facility in Cúcuta injures three civilians, including an infant, and damages homes (Al Jazeera, AP)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Cúcuta, Norte de Santander, Colombia. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified armed group. Reported casualties: 3 injured. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. 6 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1912
